local_review.finding_title: Companion Micronaut dependencies pin the tested library version
local_review.fix_note: Replaced the three hardcoded 5.1.13 companion-module versions with the existing $libraryVersion value so they track the TCK-resolved tested version. Verified the correction with git diff --check and coordinate-scoped compileTestJava and checkstyle; all passed.

The contribution is scoped to io.micronaut:micronaut-management:5.1.13, uses only reachability-metadata.json, has non-scaffold public-API tests in a separate package that run under Native Image with bounded timeouts, and reports 2/2 dynamic-access calls covered (100%). The reported 2 covered calls versus 513 total metadata entries does not trigger the mismatch guardrail. After the version-pinning correction below, the resulting tree satisfies the enumerated review rules. Coordinate-scoped compileTestJava and checkstyle both pass.
